comparison_rules: No fabricated results or tuning toward the published table
Same assets, observations, reward/cost definitions, compute and tuning budget, traffic seeds and evaluation for baseline and proposed methods
Modified human-behaviour environment is a separately labelled task and retrains every compared method
Do not use final test seeds for checkpoint selection or hyperparameter tuning
Report raw collision burden, exposure, waiting and queues; do not declare success from reduced traffic entry
Confirm promising comparisons across independent training seeds before journal superiority claims
Negative or inconclusive outcomes remain reportable; beating SOTA is not guaranteed
